correctness.rationale: Independent row-fixed uniform subsets have hypergeometric pair overlaps; conditioning on a leaf row of any forest leaves the leaf-edge overlap with fixed law independent of every other edge, giving joint product by induction. All distinct pair contributions are pairwise independent; factorial-moment expansion of (a-X)(b-X) gives exact pair mean/variance and global C-score variance sum/M^2. Independent full enumeration of 500 matrices for H=5, occupancies (2,3,4) recovers mean 7/5 and variance 49/75. In a 3-cycle over H=2, all overlaps one has probability 1/4 not 1/8, so cannot claim general joint independence or tails.
